# Research question

Replace each prompt below with your answer. Keep it to one question — population, what you're
measuring, and over what window. See the Gate 1 issue in this repository for what good looks like.

## Population

_Who, and how are they identified in the data?_

## What you're measuring

_The condition, exposure, or outcome of interest._

## Timing relative to pregnancy

_Pre-existing, onset during pregnancy, delivery, or a postpartum window. State it in actual time._

## Analytic use case

_Characterization, estimation, or prediction — and why that one._

## Feasibility notes

_What you found when you looked for concept counts. Any databases you already know will or won't
support this._

## What this study will not answer

_Scope you've deliberately excluded._
